10310980.en: She gives the fallen cultivator a cursory glance—seeing the person is still breathing, she simply turns and walks away.
10310980.ch: 她瞥了瞥那倒地修士，只见还有气息便转身离去了。

10310981.en: You see {name|B} leaning against a tree.

10310982.en: Greetings, fellow cultivator. Would you care to visit my home for a chat?
10310982.ch: 道友好，可以邀你到我家中一叙吗？

10310984.en: A pretty young lady like yourself... I've taken quite a fancy to you.
10310984.ch: 你这样好看的小姑娘，我心中十分喜欢。

10310986.en: Well... Did you hear that? My friend told you to back off.
10310986.ch: 呦，听见没？我的人让你走开。

10310988.en: I see so many nobodies every day; I doubt I'll remember you at all.
10310988.ch: 阿猫阿狗这么多，我还真不一定能记住。

10310991.en: {name|B} gives you a radiant smile, and in the blink of an eye, her graceful figure has already vanished into the distance.
10310991.ch: {name|B}朝你嫣然一笑后，只见倩影微动，她人已在远方了。

10310992.en: *giggle* My friend just told you to leave.
10310992.ch: 噗呲，我的人叫你走开呢。

10310993.en: Got a death wish? Perfect timing—my fists have been itching for some exercise!
10310993.ch: 活腻了吧？我正愁手许久没有活动活动了！

10310994.en: Oh, I don't mind if you want to fight, but I trust you won't mind if my beloved and I beat you up together?
10310994.ch: 我是不介意你要动手，但你也不介意我跟我的心上人一起打你吧？

10310996.en: Even the mightiest warrior can't fight against numbers. You better remember that.
10310996.ch: 好汉敌不过人多，给我记住。

10310997.en: But I'm no little girl. Come to think of it, you might even have to call me "grandma's sister" out of respect.
10310997.ch: 不过我不是小姑娘了。算起来，可能你还得喊我一声姑奶奶。

10310999.en: I was quite clear. If you don't get it, take your time to figure it out—after all, you'll have plenty of time to think it over. Think long and hard about it. I'm leaving.
10310999.ch: 我说得很明白了，不明白就自己慢慢想明白吧，反正你有大把时间慢慢想，好好想。走了。

10311000.en: Did I say you could leave? Wait—why can't I move? Damn you! You used an underhanded trick!
10311000.ch: 我允许你走了？咦，怎么动不了？可恶，你暗算我！

10311001.en: {name|B} turns gracefully and leaves without sparing him a single glance.
10311001.ch: {name|B}翩然转身，一眼不看此人便离开了。

10311002.en: You're nowhere close to my beloved's level. Perhaps when I lose my arms and legs, have my face burnt beyond recognition, and lose all my powers—then maybe we could share our romantic dreams together.
10311002.ch: 你和我心上人差得有点远，如果有那么一天，我断手缺腿，脸被烧成一团糊涂，修为还被废了，我们大概就可以共偕鸳梦了。

10311004.en: Let me spell it out—I'm not interested in you! Oh wait, you look quite like a Bambuki. Have you considered finding yourself a nice Sword Bambuki to pair up with?
10311004.ch: 我说，看不上你！咦，你看起来很像竹妖，有想过找剑竹妖配一对吗？

10311007.en: {name|B} stands before a dilapidated building, lost in troubled thoughts.
10311007.ch: 只见{name|B}正在一处破败建筑前沉吟苦思。

10311008.en: Oh, you're here! There's something strange about that building up ahead. Care to join me in investigating?
10311008.ch: 呦，你来了？前面的建筑颇有古怪，你陪我进去查探吗？

10311009.en: In that case, let's venture forth and explore.
10311009.ch: 既然如此，我们便冒险一探吧。

10311010.en: You follow {name|B} into the building. Under her lead, it doesn't take long before you discover countless treasures within.
10311010.ch: 你与{name|B}进入建筑，她带头行走，不多时果然发现内里大量秘宝。

10311011.en: Well, quite the haul we've got here. Keep sticking around with your big sis, and there'll be plenty more rewards coming your way.
10311011.ch: 呦，收获不错。以后多跟姐姐来往，好处少不得你的。

10311012.en: Not scared, are you? Good—let's head inside and see what we find.
10311012.ch: 你不怕？好，那我们往里面一探吧。

10311013.en: You follow {name|B} into the building, but as you walk, you both suddenly trigger a seal and find yourselves trapped in a realm of darkness where you can't see your own hands before you. All you can sense is her presence beside you—her soft breathing and the subtle fragrance of her perfume.
10311013.ch: 你与{name|B}进入建筑，行走间，你突然两触发禁制陷在一片漆黑的异境之中。其时伸手不见五指，唯有佳人在旁呼吸吐息，传来阵阵暗香。

10311014.en: Huh? Well, look where we've ended up—trapped! Don't worry, though; I am already working on breaking us out. Nothing else to do right now, so why don't you just meditate while we wait?
10311014.ch: 哈？这下好了，被困了。放心，姐姐已经着手破困，如今左右无事，你且打坐等候得了。

10311015.en: You wait quietly with {name|B}. Before long, the darkness begins to fade away. The stars and moon appear in the sky once more—the danger has passed.
10311015.ch: {name|B}与你静静等候，不多时只见周围黑暗散去，星月行天，身处危机已经解去。

10311016.en: Well, that was something. Stumbling on flat ground, weren't we? At least we got out safely. Here—I managed to snag this book on our way out. You can have it.
10311016.ch: 这下可好。阴沟里翻船，幸好没遭遇危险。这本书是我临走前顺走的。你拿去吧。

10311017.en: She places the item in your hands, gives you a gentle smile, and walks away.
10311017.ch: 她将东西交到你手，微微一笑便转身离去了。

10311018.en: *giggle* My, my... even in pitch darkness, your mind still wanders there...
10311018.ch: 噗呲，难为这伸手不见五指的情况下，你还有这心思……

10311019.en: As you join palms for Dual Cultivation, your spirits naturally merge as one. Warmth rises from your sea of Qi, flowing throughout your body and transforming into boundless joy. At this moment, the darkness around you disperses, revealing the stars and moon in the night sky—the danger has passed.
10311019.ch: 你两抵掌双修，不知不觉间心灵重合，气海腾起暖流发散全身，化作无边喜悦。正当此时周围黑暗散去，星月行天，身处危机已然解除。

10311020.en: Well... that was quite the adventure. I have some matters to attend to, so I'll take my leave first. Take care of yourself.
10311020.ch: 这……真是一次有意思的探险，我还有事，先走一步了。你自己诸事小心。

10311021.en: She gives you a long, meaningful look, seemingly lost in thought. Then, as if having come to some internal resolution, she finally turns and walks away.
10311021.ch: 她深深看了一眼，似乎若有所思，但又似下了什么决心似的，终于转身离去了。

10311022.en: You have a point—this place gives me the creeps. Who knows what kind of traps those ill-intentioned folks have hidden here? Let's go. We've got what we came for anyway.
10311022.ch: 也是，此地阴森诡异，天知道那些不安好心的人在这里藏了什么陷阱。我们走吧，左右也得了好东西了。

10311023.en: She gently takes your wrist, places some treasures in your palm, and gives you a smile before walking away.
10311023.ch: 她抓起你的手腕，将一些宝物放到你掌上，然后朝你一笑，便转身离去了。

10311024.en: I was just kidding around earlier—truth is, I've already turned this place inside out looking for treasures. Here, I brought back a little something for you.
10311024.ch: 我也只是说着玩的，其实这里面已经被我翻了个底朝天了，来，给你带的伴手礼。

10311025.en: Here are some secret techniques I copied down from the inscriptions on the walls inside. They're yours now.
10311025.ch: 这是我从里面的墙壁抄录下来的一些秘诀，你拿去吧。

10311027.en: Hey, these are some insights I gained from studying the wall inscriptions during my recent exploration. I made a copy—it's yours if you want it.
10311027.ch: 喂，这是我日前在外探索时从墙壁上摘录参悟的一些心得，我录了一个副本，送给你吧。

10311028.en: Been busy lately, haven't you? You've barely had time to practice your martial arts. Come on, let me give you some pointers.
10311028.ch: 近日很多事吧？你都懒得参悟所学功法了，来，我来指点你一下吧。

10311030.en: Finally caught you! Time to die!

10311031.en: The assailant moves with incredible speed, closing the distance in mere moments. But just then, with a whoosh through the air, strands of spider silk shoot forth, ensnaring the cultivator in a large web and leaving them completely immobilized.
10311031.ch: 来人来得很快，只片刻之间已扑到身前，然而就在同时，破空声，一股蛛丝缠来，将那修士束缚在一张大网上，动弹不得。

10311032.en: How boring. They're all yours—I'm leaving.

10311033.en: {name|B} leaves without sparing the cultivator even a glance.
10311033.ch: {name|B}看也不看那修士，便转身离开了。

10311034.en: Damn you! Let me down! Face me in mortal combat! And who was that person? How dare she meddle in our affairs!
10311034.ch: 可恶，放我下来，我们决一死战！那人是谁？怎么横加干预！

10311035.en: Hmph, without that woman's help, you would've...

10311037.en: You... spare me... Very well. Having walked the line between life and death, I feel my desire for revenge fading away...
10311037.ch: 你……饶了我……好吧，由生到死走了一遭，我复仇的心也淡漠了……

10311038.en: The cultivator slowly struggles free from the bonds and walks away in a daze...
10311038.ch: 那修士慢慢挣脱千辛万苦挣脱束缚，神情恍惚的走了……

10311039.en: This feud will only end when one of us lies dead! You won't escape me!
10311039.ch: 这桩恩怨，只会在我们之间倒下一个才能解决！我不会放过你的！

10311040.en: The cultivator breaks free from the bonds, stamps in rage, and storms away...
10311040.ch: 那修士挣脱束缚，狠狠一跺脚离开了……

10311041.en: I'm quite interested in the treasure you just won at the auction. Would you hand it over to me?
10311041.ch: 我对你刚从拍卖会拿下的宝物很感兴趣，你能否将之交给我。

10311042.en: Just as the cultivator before you reveals their killing intent, a whistling sound cuts through the air. Strands of silk shoot forth, trapping your would-be assailant in an immense web, leaving them completely immobilized.
10311042.ch: 面前修士杀气显露，恰在此时，破空声起，蜘蛛丝缠来，竟然挡在你面前的修士束缚在一张大网之上，动弹不得。

10311043.en: You look around to see {name|B}'s graceful figure flash by, gradually fading into the distance.
10311043.ch: 你回看四周，只见{name|B}倩影掠过，已渐行渐远了。

10311045.en: You want something in return? Keep dreaming! I'm warning you—let me down right now, or you'll regret it!
10311045.ch: 你还要求代价？做梦吧！我警告你，立即放我下来，否则叫你好看！

10311046.en: The matter is settled, and peace returns to the surroundings.
10311046.ch: 此事了结了，周围的环境也清净了。

10311047.en: You ignore them completely, letting their empty threats fade into nothing.
10311047.ch: 你无视此人，只任得他在当场旺旺狗吠。

10311049.en: Your righteousness makes me feel ashamed of my own wickedness... Please accept this small token of gratitude.
10311049.ch: 道友高义……倒显得我狡诈恶毒……这是一点心意。

10311050.en: Hmph, you think letting me down settles this? I'll haunt you like a vengeful spirit for all eternity, never letting you know a moment's peace!
10311050.ch: 哼，你以为放我下来就没事了？我此后必如冤魂，纠缠你一生一世，叫你日夜不得安宁。

10311054.en: Fellow cultivator, I find myself in a bit of a tight spot lately... Perhaps you could...
10311054.ch: 道友，近日我手头有些紧张，你看能不能给我……

10311055.en: Suddenly, an overwhelming pressure bears down from all directions, making it difficult to breathe. {name|B} now stands beside you, fixing the cultivator with an icy stare.
10311055.ch: 这时一股特异的感觉从四面八方压来，叫人喘息不得。只见{name|B}已站在你身边，冷冷的看着那名修士。

10311058.en: The cultivator trembles uncontrollably in fear, standing frozen for a moment before stumbling away in desperate haste...
10311058.ch: 那修士颤颤巍巍的似乎十分害怕，此人筛糠似的呆了一阵，便急忙转身踉跄逃开了……

10311060.en: {name|B} gives you a slight smile before turning to leave.
10311060.ch: {name|B}朝你微微一笑，便转身离开了。

10311061.en: These people are supposed to be the best? I highly doubt that.
10311061.ch: 这些人就是第一？只怕未必。

10311062.en: You turn around to find {name|B} standing beside you with a mischievous grin. Following her gaze, you see a group of cultivators standing outside the Cultivator Alliance in a daze, lined up like statues...
10311062.ch: 你回头看去，只见{name|B}站在你的身边，坏坏的笑着。顺她眼光看去，只见一干修士面目呆滞，齐刷刷的站在仙盟之外……

10311063.en: I'm quite curious to see if they truly deserve their reputation as Chi You's finest, so I arranged for them to come here. Don't disappoint me.
10311063.ch: 我很有兴趣知道他们是否当得起这赤幽州第一的名号，因此想法子将人请来了。不要让我失望。

10311064.en: {name|B} glances at the people outside the city, gives a knowing smile, and takes her leave.
10311064.ch: {name|B}看了看城外的人，只笑笑便走了。

10311065.en: The battle's not over yet—I'll fight by your side!
10311065.ch: 胜负还没分出，我与你并肩再战！

10311066.en: Damn it, they're too strong! We can't face them head-on today!
10311066.ch: 可恶，对手太强！今日不宜力敌！

10311067.en: Just as they attempt to flee, strands of spider silk shoot forth, binding them in place...
10311067.ch: 此人正要逃窜，一股蛛丝缠来，将他束缚在原地……

10311068.en: You dare to cause trouble and then try to run? Did you really think you'd get away so easily?
10311068.ch: 冒犯了旁人，却还想逃？有这般便宜的事吗？

10311069.en: I'll leave them to you. I have other matters to attend to, so I'll take my leave.
10311069.ch: 交给你处置，我还有有事，先走一步。

10311071.en: What are you doing here? It's going to get dangerous soon... I need to deal with a Nether Demon that's been hunting me. You should leave.
10311071.ch: 你来干嘛？待会这边可能会比较危险……我要击杀一直追踪我的冥妖，你先离开吧。

10311072.en: Alright... let's fight this enemy together. But please, don't take any unnecessary risks.
10311072.ch: 好……你我联手杀敌吧。如有危险，可千万不要逞强。

10311073.en: As they speak, the Nether Demon approaches slowly from afar, its eyes gleaming with murderous intent. However, spider silk traps had already been laid in wait—when the demon becomes entangled, it triggers the formations. Consecutive blasts erupt around it, sending the creature staggering backwards.
10311073.ch: 正说着，冥妖目露凶光，从远处慢慢接近。但周围早已布置好蛛丝，那冥妖被蛛丝牵绊后似乎触发了禁制，周围不断发生灵爆，炸得它东倒西歪，不断倒退。

10311075.en: This would have been quite troublesome without your help.
10311075.ch: 如非你从旁协助，此事倒也颇为棘手。

10311076.en: Hmph, think what you will. I'm leaving.
10311076.ch: 哼，随你喜欢怎么理解。我走了。

10311077.en: She turns away coldly and walks off, but for a brief moment, you catch a glimpse of a faint smile playing at her lips...
10311077.ch: 她冷冷的转过身，漫步而去，你仿佛间似乎察觉到她嘴角流露一丝笑意……

10311078.en: Nether Demons are formidable beings that shouldn't be underestimated. Don't take such risks again.
10311078.ch: 冥妖实力强大，不可小觑，下回可不要再冒险了。

10311079.en: She appears deeply concerned as she glances at you, letting out a soft sigh before finally turning to leave.
10311079.ch: 她似乎颇为担心的样子，她看了看你，幽幽一叹，还是转身离去了。

10311080.en: My lady, would you care to accompany me? My dwelling is spacious and bright, filled with exquisite artifacts. I guarantee you won't want to leave.
10311080.ch: 姑娘，跟我走一遭如何？在下的洞府明亮宽敞，精致法宝无数，包你流连忘返。

10311082.en: Hmph, I knew you were watching. I just wanted to see how you'd react.
10311082.ch: 哼，早知道你在旁边，想看看你有什么反应罢了。

10311083.en: Hey! I'm talking to you! How dare you ignore me to chat with someone else!
10311083.ch: 喂！我在问你，怎么反与旁人说话去了。

10311084.en: Here, take it. This person doesn't want this thing anymore.

10311085.en: As anger flashes across his face and he opens his mouth to speak, a strand of spider silk suddenly whips through the air with a whoosh, plastering itself across the cultivator's mouth. When he tries to tear it off, his hands become entangled as well. The arachnid leaves without a second glance, leaving the cultivator struggling and making muffled sounds.
10311085.ch: 这人脸现愤懑之色，还要说话，突然嗖的一声，一坨蛛丝甩来，浆糊似的封住了那修士的嘴巴，那修士待要扯开，手同时被缠。蜘蛛看也不看，只转身离开，留下那修士咿咿呀呀的挣扎。

10311086.en: I apologize, but I must ask you to leave.
10311086.ch: 抱歉，那就只有请你离开了。

10311087.en: Outrageous! Who do you think you are to interfere with me?
10311087.ch: 岂有此理！你是谁？胆敢干预我？

10311088.en: If you hadn't shown up, I would have killed him...
10311088.ch: 如非你出现，我本想把此人杀了……

10311089.en: The cultivator charges at you with ill intent, but before he can take more than two steps, silver threads shoot out and suspend him high in the air. {name|B} turns away with cool indifference, departing without sparing him another glance.
10311089.ch: 那修士不怀好意，径直向你冲来，岂知才走两步，银丝放出，已将他缠了起来高高挂在半空。{name|B}淡然转身，一眼不看此人，便转身离去了。

10311090.en: Oh really? Well, I prefer dark and sinister dwellings. I have no interest in ordinary cultivator abodes.
10311090.ch: 是吗？可我喜欢阴暗诡异的洞府，我对一般修士的洞府没兴趣。

10311091.en: Aw, come on! Just for a bit!

10311092.en: As the cultivator tries to grab {name|B}, she whirls around to reveal her true form. Above her tall, graceful figure emerges a terrifying giant arachnid that roars at the cultivator. He turns deathly pale, and by the time he recovers his senses, {name|B} is long gone.
10311092.ch: 那修士想要抓住{name|B}，但她转身显出真身幻形，她窈窕高挑的身形之上，仿佛出现一只巨大可怖的蜘蛛妖朝着那修士咆哮，那修士顿时脸无人色到他恢复过来时，{name|B}早已去得远了。

10311094.en: But {gender|A} wants to talk to you.

10311095.en: Suddenly, a Mythical Beast pounces fiercely at the cultivator, pinning him to the ground. In panic, the cultivator manages to roll over and engage in combat with the monster.
10311095.ch: 只见一只大妖兽朝那修士猛扑而来一把将其按在地上，那修士慌乱中翻身而起与妖兽斗了起来。

10311096.en: This monster has been following me for half a month; it's quite a devoted stalker. Why don't you keep it company instead? Forget about me.
10311096.ch: 这妖兽跟踪我半月，最是痴缠，你好好待它，忘了我吧。

10311097.en: {name|B} leaves with an indifferent expression, not sparing a single glance at the other party. The person ultimately falls to the monster, their body dissolved by its Nether Air. Only a few personal belongings remain scattered about, among them a conspicuously placed artifact lying askew.
10311097.ch: {name|B}神色漠然，看也不看对方，便转身离开了。而那人最终不敌妖兽，被其冥气销解，只剩零丁几件随身物品，当中赫然有一件法宝歪斜着搁着。

10311098.en: Halt! A Mythical Beast is wreaking havoc in Chi You ahead. I plan to lure and kill it—you should leave now.
10311098.ch: 停步！前方赤幽州大妖兽肆虐，我将之诱来击杀，你先离开吧。

10311100.en: As she speaks, she turns to look ahead. Countless silk threads stretch across the path, nearly invisible save for their faint gleam in the sunlight. A monster slowly advances, stepping into the spider web formation. Suddenly, multiple blasts erupt, the explosions sending the monster reeling.
10311100.ch: 正说着，她回头看向前方。只见无数丝线横在前方，如非日光下闪烁白光，几不可见。一只妖兽缓缓前行，踏入蛛网阵中，突然间灵爆四起，轰得那妖兽东倒西歪。

10311101.en: Now's our chance to slay the monster! Strike now!
10311101.ch: 击杀妖兽，正是良机！出手吧！

10311102.en: Perfect. I've been waiting to put down this wretched beast.
10311102.ch: 很好，这孽畜我早想除了。

10311103.en: She gives a slight smile and turns to leave. For a brief moment, you catch a glimmer of concern in her eyes, but before you can be certain, she's already gone.
10311103.ch: 她微微一笑，正要转身离去，仿佛间，她瞧你的眼神之中流露关注神色，还待细看时，她人已经去得远了。

10311105.en: Just as she turns to look ahead, the ground suddenly splits open with a thunderous crack, sending both of you plummeting into the abyss. With a flash of alertness in her eyes, she swiftly grabs you, guiding your fall into a pitch-black cavern.
10311105.ch: 正说着，她回头看向前方，但突然间地面开裂，轰隆声中你两跌落深渊。她眼中冷电放出，一把拉着你落在一处黑麻麻的地洞之中。

10311106.en: Hmph, quite perceptive of it to notice my spider silk. And clever enough to turn my own trap against me.
10311106.ch: 哼，倒也机警，发现了我的蛛丝。反向我施袭，将我困住。

10311107.en: As she turns to look at you, a fleeting glimpse of regret crosses her face. Suddenly, something occurs to her—her eyes flash with a strange light. Before you can react, you feel a slight sting at your pressure points, and your hands are bound by spider silk. She moves in close, studying you intently.
10311107.ch: 她回头看你之际，歉然之色一闪而过。但她瞬间想到了什么，眼中异光一闪，你但觉脉门处微痛，双手已被蛛丝束缚住。她一把凑了过来打量着你。

10311108.en: I've sent my arachnids to find a way out. While we wait... shall we perform some Dual Cultivation?
10311108.ch: 我已派出蜘蛛出去寻路，眼下无事，不如双修？

10311109.en: In the darkness, you and {name|B} join palms in Dual Cultivation. As energy flows between you, the spider silk around you vibrates with a gentle hum. Unconsciously, you both enter a state of pure, transcending enlightenment, and your two spirits filled with boundless joy.
10311109.ch: 漆黑之中，你与{name|B}并掌双修，随着灵力此来彼去，蛛丝因此产生振动，发出嗡嗡的微响，不知不觉间，你两空明反照，遁入无我之境，心田间只余无限喜悦。

10311110.en: After what seems like an eternity, sounds echo from afar as her arachnids return one by one, revealing the path ahead. She ends her cultivation first, then leads you away from this place.
10311110.ch: 良久良久，远方传来声响，她放出的小蜘蛛陆续回归，为你两指明前路，她当先收功，领着你离开此间。

10311111.en: Sorry for getting you trapped down here with me. At least we made it out. I'll be going now.
10311111.ch: 害你陪我困在地脉之中了，所幸脱困了，我走了。

10311112.en: A hint of disappointment flickers across her face as she reaches out to break the spider silk binding your wrists.
10311112.ch: 她似乎掠过一丝失望，伸手处扯断你腕上蛛丝。

10311113.en: Let's wait here a while. We'll find our way out soon.
10311113.ch: 我们待一会吧，很快就能出去了。

10311116.en: Oh? You're hunting this Nether Demon? Not sure if this will count... I might have gone a bit overboard during the fight. All that's left of the demon are these remains.
10311116.ch: 怎么？你要除这冥妖？不知道这作数不，交战过程中下手重了，这冥妖只剩下这些残骸了。

10311117.en: {name|B} blinks innocently, pulls out half an arm from behind her back, holds it out to you, then turns and walks away as if this was the most normal thing in the world...
10311117.ch: 只见{name|B}眨了眨眼，从身后掏出半条手臂递到你面前，然后像个没事人一样转身离开了……

10440001.en: Hmph, I've always expected nothing but cold stares and drawn weapons from others. Come at me!
10440001.ch: 哼，旁人冷眼相对，刀剑相向本来就在我意料之中，来吧！

10440012.en: But why don't you figure it out yourself...
10440012.ch: 你有手有脚，干嘛自己不去设法弄来……

10440101.en: I knew this day would come. Let's fight!
10440101.ch: 我早就知道会有这么一天，来战吧！

10440105.en: You should seek help from someone else.

10440107.en: You! You... please just go away?

10440109.en: The true path lies in each person's heart—what is there to debate?
10440109.ch: 道在各人心中，有什么可论的？

10440110.en: Didn't I tell you not to bother me unless it's important?
10440110.ch: 不是让你没事别来找我吗？

10440111.en: Why do you keep pestering me? You're... you're an eyesore... Get out of here.
10440111.ch: 你为什么还来跟我啰嗦，你、你很碍眼……快走开。

10440202.en: You... think you can fool me?
10440202.ch: 你……想试试能不能瞒过我吧？

10440203.en: Bond with you? I'm not interested...

10440204.en: I'm sorry, but I cannot accept. The cold energy within me will only harm anyone who comes close...
10440204.ch: 对不起，我无法答应你。身怀寒气的我，只会让一切靠近我的人受到伤害……

10440206.en: Stay with me, and you'll only be infected by my cold energy.
10440206.ch: 跟我待在一起，只会让你沾染上寒气。

10440207.en: Dual Cultivation is dangerous—one wrong move could destroy both body and spirit. My cold energy would affect you...
10440207.ch: 性命双修，一着不慎即有身死道消的危险，我体内的寒气会影响你的……

10440208.en: I'm afraid... I might unconsciously pass my cold energy to you...
10440208.ch: 我怕……不经意间将寒气传给了你……

10440209.en: I refuse. A debate won't free me from my current predicament.
10440209.ch: 我拒绝，论道没办法让我摆脱眼下的困境。

10440210.en: Purging this energy from my body may be impossibly difficult, but I... I won't give up.
10440210.ch: 驱除体内寒气千难万难，但我……不会放弃的。

10440211.en: I've always managed to bounce back from disappointment and despair, but I fear one day I'll completely lose hope and never recover...
10440211.ch: 一直以来会泄气，会失望，但我总能重新振作，只是不知道哪天会彻底失去信心，从此一蹶不振……

10440212.en: Nothing in this world comes without effort. Find your own way...
10440212.ch: 天下间没有不劳而获的东西，自己去想办法……

10440213.en: I... don't need this item. I appreciate the kind gesture.
10440213.ch: 我……不需要此物，好意心领了。

10440214.en: Joining a sect would only lead to more people looking at me with contempt...
10440214.ch: 加入宗门，只会让更多的人对我投以冷眼……

10440301.en: I knew this day would come... If it's a fight you want, so be it...
10440301.ch: 我早就知道会有这么一天……要战便战吧……

10440303.en: Don't you understand? I can't get close to anyone; I just can't!
10440303.ch: 你还不懂吗？我不能跟任何一人交好，不能！

10440304.en: The heart runs deep, but fate is shallow...

10440306.en: I... won't go anywhere with you...
10440306.ch: 我……不会跟你去任何地方的……

10440310.en: Get away! I'll only bring you harm, bring everyone harm...
10440310.ch: 你走开！我只会害了你，害了每一个人……

10440311.en: Everyone who gets close to me meets a terrible fate...
10440311.ch: 靠近我的人，都没有好下场的……

10440312.en: Even just taking something from me will lead you to a terrible fate...
10440312.ch: 即使只是拿了我的东西，你也不会有好下场的……

10440401.en: In that case, show me what you can do!

10440403.en: I feel that... this isn't the kind of relationship we should have.
10440403.ch: 我觉得……我们不应该是这样的关系。

10440404.en: If you've thought it through, and you're willing to accept someone like me, then... then I would like to... be with you too.
10440404.ch: 如果考虑清楚了，愿意接纳这样的我，那、那我也是愿意和你……在一起的。

10440407.en: I'm sorry, but I don't want to turn such a paradise into a frozen cavern.
10440407.ch: 对不起，我不想将那鸟语花香的地方，变作一处冰窟。

10440408.en: Actually... I'd really like to perform Dual Cultivation with you too.
10440408.ch: 其实……我也很想和你双修的。

10440409.en: In that case, let's have a friendly spar. We'll keep it light.
10440409.ch: 既然如此，我们便比试比试吧。咱们点到即止好了。

10440410.en: Everyone has their own path to follow. I won't impose my beliefs on others.
10440410.ch: 每个人都有自己的道，我不愿意将自己的想法强加于别人。

10440411.en: I thought surviving in the world was a stroke of incredible fortune, but it turned out to be just the beginning of a nightmare.
10440411.ch: 来到八荒保住性命，以为万分侥幸，但原来这只是恶梦的开始。

10440412.en: Thankfully, you helped me find my strength again.
10440412.ch: 所幸有你，我才能再次振作起来。

10440413.en: I keep having this dream where I take a single misstep and fall into an endless abyss of darkness...
10440413.ch: 我总是梦见一脚踏空，从此跌入无穷无尽的黑暗之中的情景……

10440414.en: Having you by my side is the greatest blessing of my life, but I'm afraid of becoming too dependent on all of this...
10440414.ch: 能够有你相伴是我此生之幸，但我也怕自己会依赖这一切……

10440415.en: I truly hope that one day I can purge this cold from my body, so we can go on spring walks together, climb mountains, and explore every interesting corner of the city...
10440415.ch: 真盼望有朝一日能够彻底排除体内的寒气，和你去踏青去登临高山，去城中逛遍好玩的东西……

10440416.en: Since you like it, you should have it.

10440417.en: Thank you... I never thought anyone would give me a gift again.
10440417.ch: 谢谢你……没想到，还能有人送我东西。

10440418.en: Thank you... receiving your gift makes me... makes me so happy.
10440418.ch: 谢谢你……收到你的礼物，我、我很开心。

10440419.en: I'm sorry, but I can't accept. I... I'm not meant to be around others.
10440419.ch: 对不起，我不能答应你。我……不合适和其他人待在一起的。

10441001.en: Fine then! I don't know what this is about, but if you want a fight, I'll give you one!
10441001.ch: 好吧，虽然我不知道为什么，不过你要打我也奉陪！

10441002.en: You could have just asked me, you know? Stealing isn't very honorable.
10441002.ch: 你要可以跟我说啊，偷，这多不光彩啊。

10441003.en: Look how tiny I am—I can't possibly be your mother, right? But I don't want to be your little sister either!
10441003.ch: 你看我这么娇小，不可能当你娘吧？可我也不乐意当你的小妹妹呀。

10441004.en: W-wait, no! No! It's nothing like that at all!
10441004.ch: 别别别！我们根本不是那回事好吗！

10441005.en: Haha, no way, absolutely not! Master and disciple? You and me? What kind of bizarre combination would that be?
10441005.ch: 哈哈，不行不行！师徒？你和我？这是个什么奇怪的组合？

10441006.en: No. All those places look exactly the same anyway. What's so fun about that?
10441006.ch: 不去。那些个地方长得都一个样，有什么好玩的？

10441007.en: Huh? I'm too young to know anything about Dual Cultivation. Go find someone who does.
10441007.ch: 哈？我年纪轻，不懂什么叫双修，你找懂的去。

10441008.en: I won't fight you! I'm far too delicate—you'd knock me over with a single strike!
10441008.ch: 我不跟你打！我这么娇弱，你一掌就把我拍倒了。

10441009.en: I won't debate with you. If you've got that much free time, you might as well go explore some mystic realms instead.
10441009.ch: 我不跟你论，有这闲情，还不如去找个洞天逛逛。

10441010.en: In this world, nothing matters more than being truly free.
10441010.ch: 在这世上，最重要的就是自由自在。

10441011.en: Go on, take it! If you like it, it's yours!

10441012.en: Since you're so sincere about it, I'll gladly accept!
10441012.ch: 既然你一片心意，我收下了！

10441013.en: No way. These sects are all about strict rules, and everyone there is stiff as a board. I'd lose my mind if I had to stay in a place like that for even half a day.
10441013.ch: 不要，这些个宗门，条规森严，一个个人都呆若木鸡，这种地方留个半天我都要疯掉。

10441201.en: So you refuse to be my friend... Very well. Let us settle this with combat—win or lose, we'll be strangers after today.
10441201.ch: 你就是不乐意和我当朋友……好吧，今日一战，无论胜负，从此我们都是陌路人了。

10441202.en: Oh my, are you playing sneaky thief? Well then, congratulations on successfully stealing an item from me!
10441202.ch: 哎呦，你这是偷着玩吗？好吧，你成功从我身上偷走了一件物品啦！

10441203.en: Parents and children, brothers and sisters... I've thought it over, and I just don't see how any of these family bonds could work between us.
10441203.ch: 父母子女，兄弟姐妹，思前想后，就没觉得我们之间能够对上这些组合。

10441204.en: Sorry, but I'm too young for romance!
10441204.ch: 对不起，我还没到谈情说爱的年纪呢！

10441205.en: I refuse! I can't be your Master, and I definitely won't be your Apprentice!
10441205.ch: 我拒绝！我当不了你的师父，更不乐意做你徒弟！

10441206.en: No way. That's no fun at all! Next time, let's go explore a scenic realm together instead!
10441206.ch: 不去。那个不好玩！下回我找个风景明媚的洞天和你一起去玩好了！

10441207.en: Hehe, that won't work! The Martial Arts I practice doesn't allow Dual Cultivation with others.
10441207.ch: 嘻嘻，不可以！我修习的功法不能与旁人双修。

10441208.en: All this fighting and killing is such a bore.
10441208.ch: 打打杀杀什么的最无聊了。

10441209.en: No way, what's so fun about a debate? I forfeit—you win!
10441209.ch: 不要，论道有什么好玩的？我认输，算你赢！

10441210.en: Back home, I always wanted someone to keep me company, but everyone was busy with their own things. In the end, I was always alone.
10441210.ch: 以前在家啊，我总想找个人陪着我，可大家都忙自己的。最后也只有我自己一个。

10441211.en: Hmm, have you ever imagined that your friend might be a monster? You know, the kind with huge, glaring eyes and horns on their head, looking absolutely terrifying!
10441211.ch: 唔，如果你有没有想过你身边的朋友是个怪物，瞪着大眼睛，头顶还有犄角，凶神恶煞那种！

10441213.en: Gifts from friends are just different. In the past, things were more like formal offerings—not genuine gifts meant to make me happy.
10441213.ch: 朋友给送的东西就是好。以前啊，给到我的东西更像是呈上来的，并不是真心诚意送我，哄我开心的。

10441214.en: Going to such a strict and disciplined place? I'd probably die of boredom by day two!
10441214.ch: 跑到那种戒律森严的地方，我估计第二天我就会因为无聊而死掉！

10441301.en: If you wish to fight, I shall oblige. Death awaits me anyway—perhaps falling by your hand wouldn't be such a bad end...
10441301.ch: 你要打，我奉陪。左右是死，死在你手上也未尝不是一件好事……

10441302.en: How is this supposed to be fun? I just don't get it!

10441303.en: No—way! Hey, what kind of weird request is that? Do I look like your mother or your sister to you?
10441303.ch: 不——要！喂，你这是什么奇怪的要求？我看起来像你娘还是你妹子？

10441304.en: If I can't go back, I'm going to die! And you're still here spouting nonsense!
10441304.ch: 回不去，我就要死啦，还给我说这些傻话！

10441305.en: Haha, I get it! You're just joking with me, right?
10441305.ch: 哈哈，我懂了！你在跟我开玩笑是吧！

10441307.en: Sigh... I'm not in the mood for jokes right now.
10441307.ch: 唉……我没心思和你开这种玩笑啦。

10441308.en: I'm not in the mood, I'm sorry...

10441309.en: I'm sorry, but I need to focus on finding a way to escape from the world.
10441309.ch: 对不起，我想抓紧时间去寻找离开八荒的法子。

10441310.en: This is a matter of life and death—I won't give up even the slightest hope.
10441310.ch: 生死事大，我不会放弃任何一丝希望的。

10441311.en: If I were alone, I might have given up already. But with you by my side, I always find the strength to keep going!
10441311.ch: 如果只有我一个，可能我就直接放弃了。但有你陪着，我总是能再次激发决心！

10441312.en: I used to think I was fearless, but now that death draws ever closer, I can't help but feel afraid...
10441312.ch: 原以为自己天不怕地不怕，但如今死亡步步接近，心中还是十分不安……

10441314.en: Thank you. I know you're just trying to cheer me up because you don't want me to be sad.
10441314.ch: 谢谢你，我知道你是怕我难过，所以哄我开心。

10441315.en: Please, have mercy! If I enter a sect, I'll die!
10441315.ch: 饶了我吧！进入宗门，我会死掉的！

10441401.en: After everything I went through to return to the world, I didn't expect you would turn against me...
10441401.ch: 没想到我千辛万苦回到八荒，你却要对我动手……

10441402.en: Uh... do you actually think theft is some kind of game?
10441402.ch: 呃……你是不是觉得这样偷窃很好玩？

10441403.en: Hah! I won't be your child or your parent, and I certainly won't be your sibling!
10441403.ch: 噗呲，我不会做你父母子女，更不会当你的兄弟姐妹！

10441404.en: Yes! Let's explore all the mystic realms together!
10441404.ch: 好啊，以后我们一起逛遍各种洞天！

10441405.en: I... I will marry you... but you—you must never betray me!
10441405.ch: 我愿意和你结为夫妻的……但你、你以后不能负我！

10441406.en: No way, a master-disciple relationship would be too weird for us!
10441406.ch: 不要，师徒关系对于我们很奇怪呢！

10441407.en: That place is so boring! How about I find somewhere more exciting, and we go there instead?
10441407.ch: 我觉得那个地方太无趣啦！待以后我整个更有趣的地方，咱们一起去玩吧？

10441409.en: Sure, but watch out! I've been diligently cultivating even during my time back home!
10441409.ch: 好，但你可要小心咯，我回家一趟也是有勤奋修炼的！

10441410.en: I still hate these cultivation debates—they're so boring!
10441410.ch: 我还是不喜欢论道，无聊得很！

10441411.en: Thank heavens, I've finally returned to the world.
10441411.ch: 天可怜见，总算回到八荒了。

10441412.en: My experiences in the world have taught me to cherish what I have—my royal father, my friends, and you...
10441412.ch: 有了八荒的经历，我更珍惜拥有的东西了，好比父王、朋友，还有你……

10441413.en: I feared I'd return to find the world completely transformed, but thankfully, everything is still here—and so are you.
10441413.ch: 我以为再次回来，八荒已是沧海桑田，所幸一切还在，你也还在。

10441414.en: They say joy and sorrow always come hand in hand. Like that day when I left—your plea for my return filled me with boundless happiness, yet our parting plunged me into the depths of sorrow and despair.
10441414.ch: 总说快乐与悲伤总是伴随相生的，正如那天我离开之际，你让我一定要回来，我开心到无以复加，但分别又让我感到无比难过与绝望。

10441415.en: My royal father once said that life is about finding something worth fighting for with all your might. After leaving the world, I realized I'd found exactly what I'd give everything to protect.
10441415.ch: 父王说，活着就是要找到为之拼命的事情。离开八荒以后，我就知道我已经找到要为之拼命付出一切的事了。

10441416.en: I've always let the beauty around me slip away without realizing it. This time, I'll cherish and treasure everything important with all my heart.
10441416.ch: 我总是不知不觉错过了身边的美好，这次我要竭尽全力地去珍惜去关注身边一切重要的东西。

10441417.en: If you find anything I have useful, feel free to take it.
10441417.ch: 我身上的东西，你要觉得有用，尽管拿去。

10441418.en: No need for thanks between us, but I'm still really happy about your gift.
10441418.ch: 我们之间道谢就免了，不过收到你的礼物我还是很开心呢。

10441419.en: How could you bear to leave a delicate flower like me to wither away in that lifeless sect?
10441419.ch: 你忍心把我这花朵般的姑娘，放到那了无生气的宗门里面，慢慢枯萎吗？

10442001.en: Very well! I haven't felt the thrill of battle in ages. Let's settle this with a duel to the death!
10442001.ch: 好啊，姐姐久未动杀心了，今天来决个生死吧！

10442002.en: My, what mischievous hands you have.

10442003.en: That wouldn't be proper now, would it? Are you trying to call me mother, or do you actually want to call me Older Sister?
10442003.ch: 这不合适吧，你是想喊我作妈，还是真的想喊我姐姐？

10442004.en: I'm sorry, but I have grown used to being alone all these years. I'm not looking for a companion.
10442004.ch: 对不起啊，这么多年来，姐姐一个人过习惯了，并没打算找个伴儿。

10442005.en: That won't do at all. If you become my apprentice, I fear you'll be led astray. If I become your apprentice, I fear I'll be led astray too.
10442005.ch: 这可不行，你当我徒弟，我怕你学坏了，我当你徒弟嘛，又怕我学坏了。

10442006.en: I spend every day risking life and limb with you—how could I find time to compose poetry in some idyllic garden?
10442006.ch: 姐姐天天忙着与你出生入死，哪来闲工夫到那鸟语花香的地方吟诗作对？

10442008.en: No, you're taking advantage of me! I have been stuck with books for so long without practice, and my martial arts have grown rusty.
10442008.ch: 不行，你这不是欺负人吗？姐姐受困书中，已久不动武，道法身手早生疏了。

10442009.en: Nothing pleases me more than a good debate.
10442009.ch: 姐姐我最喜欢与旁人论道了。

10442013.en: No can do. I am quite the pauper, you see!
10442013.ch: 不可以。姐姐穷困得很呢。

10442014.en: My, my! You certainly know how to win my heart! I like it—why not send a few more?
10442014.ch: 哎呦，好会哄姐姐欢心啊，我喜欢，你再多送几个啊。

10442015.en: I am but a free spirit, a wild crane soaring among the clouds! Asking me to be cooped up in your sect would be like putting me in prison.
10442015.ch: 姐姐乃是天边闲云一野鹤，你让我随你到宗门里坐牢，不是为难我吗？

10442301.en: After this battle, whether we live or die, all ties between us will be forever severed!
10442301.ch: 今日一战，无论生死，从此以后，恩断义绝！

10442302.en: Do that again, and I will chop those hands right off!
10442302.ch: 再做这种事，姐姐剁了你的手！

10442303.en: No. You must be joking with me, right?
10442303.ch: 拒绝，你在和姐姐说笑是吧？

10442304.en: I have agreed! Now go find somewhere private to celebrate your good fortune!
10442304.ch: 姐姐答应了，快找个地方偷着乐吧。

10442305.en: Sigh. Since you're so sincere about it, I will do you the favor of being your companion!
10442305.ch: 唉，看在你一片诚心的份上，姐姐就勉为其难与你当个伴儿吧。

10442306.en: I have no interest in taking an apprentice, much less becoming someone's apprentice myself. You may leave now.
10442306.ch: 姐姐不乐意收徒弟，更不愿拜个师父。你可以走了。

10442307.en: No can do! I need to stay home and read books.
10442307.ch: 不去，姐姐还要在家里看书呢。

10442308.en: Very well. Promise me this: during our Dual Cultivation, you must maintain absolute focus. Should your mind wander even slightly... I will know.
10442308.ch: 来吧。答应我，双修之际，一定要心无旁骛。你如有丝毫，分心，姐姐可是能觉察到的。

10442309.en: We are cultured individuals, aren't we? All this grabbing and touching—where are your manners?
10442309.ch: 咱们都是斯文人，这动手动脚的，成何体统了？

10442310.en: Go on then! Share your pearls of wisdom. Let's see if you can enlighten me with your profound insights!
10442310.ch: 来来来，说几个至理名言，让姐姐醍醐灌顶，茅塞顿开吧。

10442311.en: Never in my wildest dreams did I imagine that the one I saw as my nemesis would go to such lengths to protect me.
10442311.ch: 万万不曾想过，那个宿敌一般的人，竟千方百计地保护我。

10442312.en: I have missed you! How about giving me a smile first?
10442312.ch: 姐姐很想念你，先给姐姐笑一个？

10442313.en: You troublemaker... I both love and hate you so!
10442313.ch: 像你这样冤家，姐姐是既爱且恨呐。

10442314.en: Lou Ye must be backed by a massive organization—one that has infiltrated the world, secretly pulling the strings of countless cultivators.
10442314.ch: 娄夜的背后肯定有一个庞大的组织，他们渗透了八荒，暗暗操控着芸芸修士。

10442315.en: Have you been keeping up with your studies lately? Do I need to supervise you?
10442315.ch: 最近有没有好好学习，要不要姐姐督促你一下?

10442316.en: I love seeing you all confused and flustered! You look absolutely adorable that way.
10442316.ch: 姐姐爱看你犯迷糊，那样子十足的惹人怜爱。

10442317.en: Sigh. Here, take it. If it's you asking... I would give you anything.
10442317.ch: 唉，拿去吧。你要的话，姐姐什么都给。

10442318.en: Thank you, you little rascal! You really know how to make me happy.
10442318.ch: 谢谢，你这家伙，很会哄姐姐开心啊。

10442319.en: I have always lived free as the wind—I can't stand even the slightest constraint.
10442319.ch: 姐姐一贯逍遥自在惯了，受不得半点束缚。

10442322.en: I... can't remember... I can't remember anything...
10442322.ch: 我……记不起来……什么都不记得了……

10442323.en: I don't... understand what you mean.

10442326.en: Oh... you want to take this thing from me? Go ahead; it's fine.
10442326.ch: 噢……你意思是想从我这拿走这东西是吗？你拿，没关系的。

10442327.en: You mean... you're giving this to me? Thank you... thank you.
10442327.ch: 你的意思是，要把这个东西送给我？谢谢……你。

10442333.ch: 你……从我这拿走了个东西……

10442334.en: Attack! You're going to attack me! Aah! (screams)
10442334.ch: 攻击！你要攻击我！啊！（尖叫）

10442335.en: I try to understand others, but I always feel there's a disconnect between what people say and what they truly think.
10442335.ch: 我试着去了解别人，但总觉得旁人嘴里说的，和心里想的不太一样。

10442336.en: I've been trying so hard to learn, but I still feel like I don't understand anything at all.
10442336.ch: 我已经很努力去学习了，但总感觉自己还是什么都不懂。

10442337.en: Could you... stay with me for more time? I feel like I keep getting into trouble without meaning to.
10442337.ch: 你……能多陪陪我吗？总感觉一不小心就闯祸了。

10442338.en: When you're by my side, this organ called heart feels at peace.
10442338.ch: 只要你陪着我，那个称为心的脏腑就有一种踏实的感觉。

10442339.en: I have countless questions in my heart, and this house seems to hold the answers I seek. I must build it properly!
10442339.ch: 我心中有无数的疑惑，而这间房子似乎藏着我想要的答案，我一定要把它建好！

10442340.en: Huh? I-I don't want to be your mother!

10442341.en: I don't understand what you mean... Let me figure it out first, then we'll talk!
10442341.ch: 我不懂你的意思……等我弄懂了，再说吧！

10442342.en: I understand what you mean, but I don't think we can have that kind of relationship!
10442342.ch: 这个我知道，但我觉得我们不能成为那样子的关系！

10442343.en: Go ahead and take it if you like, it's fine.
10442343.ch: 你喜欢就拿走吧，没关系。

10442345.en: I've heard that getting too hands-on isn't proper, you know.
10442345.ch: 我听旁人说，动手动脚，不好呢。

10442346.en: I've seen other cultivators perform Dual Cultivation. It's too dangerous—I can't risk harming you!
10442346.ch: 我看过其他修士双修，很危险的，我不能害了你！

10442347.en: No, no, no! The principles in debates are too profound—my head will turn to mush!
10442347.ch: 别别别！论道的道理太过深奥，会让我头脑乱成一团浆糊！

10442348.en: Absolutely not! Something about this invitation feels suspicious!
10442348.ch: 不行！我总感觉这邀约并不单纯！

10442349.en: I can't. If I join a sect, I'll just keep making mistakes and upsetting everyone!
10442349.ch: 不可以，我要是加入到宗门里一定会频频犯错，惹大家不快的！

10442350.en: Huh? Did you take something from me?
10442350.ch: 咦？你是从我这儿拿走了什么东西吗？

10442351.en: You're going to kill me! You're going to kill me! You're just like that person! (screams)
10442351.ch: 你要杀死我！你要杀死我！你跟那人一样！（尖叫）

10442352.en: Fragments keep floating through my mind... I see another version of myself there... That person did terrible things...
10442352.ch: 我的脑海里浮现很多片段，那里面也有一个我，那个人做了可怕的事情……

10442353.en: What am I, really? Where did I come from? Where am I going...
10442353.ch: 我到底是什么？我是从哪来的，我要去哪里……

10442354.en: I must uncover the truth... all of it...

10442355.en: I have this feeling... that you won't stay with me forever...
10442355.ch: 我总感觉，你不会一直陪着我……

10442356.en: I don't even know what I truly am—how could I rashly accept your request?
10442356.ch: 我甚至不知道自己到底是什么，怎能贸然答应你的请求呢？

10442359.en: Huh? Ah! You... just take it.

10442361.en: No... I'm afraid I might hurt you by accident during our fight...
10442361.ch: 不可以……我怕交手之际会不经意伤害了你……

10442363.en: I haven't even figured out what I am—how could I possibly discuss such profound truths with you?
10442363.ch: 我连自己是什么都没弄明白，又怎么和你讲论那些高深的道理呢？

10442364.en: I'm sorry, I... I must figure out what's happening right now first.
10442364.ch: 不好意思，我……必须先把眼前的事情弄明白。

10442368.en: You gave me the chance to choose—to break free from others' constraints.
10442368.ch: 你给了我一个选择的机会，让我能够摆脱旁人的束缚。

10442369.en: I have countless questions about all living beings in this world, and I will find the answers to them all!
10442369.ch: 关于世上的生灵，我心中存有无数疑问，今后我要把这一切弄明白！

10442370.en: Now that I understand everything, it feels like a great weight has been lifted from my heart.
10442370.ch: 弄明白一切以后，心中好像放下了一块大石。

10442371.en: I am who I am—I make mistakes, I get confused, but I will surely become a better version of myself.
10442371.ch: 我还是我，会犯错，会糊涂，也一定会成为更好的我。

10442372.en: I'm sorry, but I cannot form a sworn bond with you. I know our feelings for each other aren't like that.
10442372.ch: 对不起，我不会和你结义的，我知道我们之间的情感不是那样的。

10442373.en: Yes! Let's become partners! I understand its means.
10442373.ch: 好！我们结为道侣吧！我明白道侣是什么意思。

10442374.en: Alright, but remember—you can't grow tired of me in the future!
10442374.ch: 好，但你要记住，以后不能嫌弃我！

10442375.en: I'm sorry, but I cannot become your master or disciple. I know our feelings for each other aren't like that.
10442375.ch: 对不起，我不会和你结为师徒的，我知道我们之间的情感不是那样的。

10442376.en: Everything I can give is yours for the taking!
10442376.ch: 但凡我能给的，你都可以要！

10442377.en: Thank you for your gift. My organ called heart feels an inexplicable happiness.
10442377.ch: 谢谢你，收到你的礼物，那个叫心的脏器莫名有一股幸福的感觉。

10442378.en: I don't like fighting—someone could get hurt if I'm not careful.
10442378.ch: 我不喜欢打打杀杀的，一个不小心就伤到人啦。

10442380.en: Debating is too hard! You're making it difficult for me on purpose!
10442380.ch: 论道太难了！你不能故意为难我！

10442381.en: What's so fun about over there? Adventuring in the Fallen Valley would be way more exciting!
10442381.ch: 那边有什么好玩的？去陨幽谷冒险就比那有意思多了！

10442382.en: No! There are too many people... I'm not good with crowds.

10442383.en: Did you take something from me?
10442383.ch: 你是不是从我这拿了什么东西？

10442384.en: I knew you'd end up hating me, just like that person who beat and tried to kill me... But I'm not afraid anymore—I won't show any mercy!
10442384.ch: 我就知道你最终会讨厌我，就像那人一样打我杀我……但我已经不会再害怕了，我不会手下留情的！

10442385.en: The way of heaven knows no mercy, and all life beneath it silently follows this principle. What we call virtue and morality is nothing but self-deception.
10442385.ch: 天道无情，人生天地间，也默默地遵循了这个原则。所谓仁义道德，也不过自欺欺人罢了。

10442386.en: What is life and death compared to unveiling the mysteries of the world?
10442386.ch: 只要能够探明八荒的奥秘，生死又何足道哉？

10442387.en: Interesting. Chi You is the most dangerous region in all the world, yet you dare to venture in so recklessly.
10442387.ch: 有意思，如今赤幽州乃八荒最为凶险之地，你竟敢贸然闯入。

10442388.en: These countless cultivators are nothing but mindless sheep. You, however... you're actually somewhat different.
10442388.ch: 芸芸修士，不过都是些蠢牛木马罢了。至于你，倒有点与众不同。

10442389.en: Moral codes and ethics are merely human delusions. I have no need for them.
10442389.ch: 纲纪人伦，是人类一厢情愿的产物，我不需要。

10442390.en: I can unravel a thousand tangled webs, yet I cannot make sense of a single thread of affection. Such matters are beyond my grasp—please speak no more of this.
10442390.ch: 万般蛛丝尚可捋，一点深情莫能理，这种东西我驾驭不来，请你莫再重提此事。

10442391.en: Do not entertain such foolish thoughts.

10442392.en: Material possessions mean nothing to me. If you want them, take them all.
10442392.ch: 身外之物，无足轻重，你要的话，尽可拿去。

10442394.en: Sparring? What's that other word for it? Ah yes—child's play. I have no interest in child's play.
10442394.ch: 切磋？有个说法是什么来着？对，过家家，我对过家家没兴趣。

10442395.en: Our Martial Arts are fundamentally different. Forcing a Dual Cultivation would only bring harm to both parties.
10442395.ch: 你我所修功法大有不同，强行双修，只会于对方有害。

10442396.en: The way of heaven defies description. To capture it in mere words would yield nothing but worthless dregs.
10442396.ch: 天道莫可名状，诉诸言语，得到的只是一堆糟粕渣滓。

10442397.en: I have no interest in your proposal, good cultivator.
10442397.ch: 我对阁下提议不感兴趣。

10442400.en: Hmph. Humans see us as nothing but monsters. There's nothing left to discuss—let's settle this with our lives.
10442400.ch: 哼，人类视妖为外道邪魔，这也没什么好说的，决一生死吧。

10442401.en: No living being can truly think rationally. Even I am not immune to this failing...
10442401.ch: 一切生灵都无法理性思考，即使是我，也未能免俗……

10442402.en: If you're not afraid of death, feel free to join me in slaying Nether Demons and hunting monsters. I'll be waiting.
10442402.ch: 若不怕死，不妨多来与我击杀冥妖，清理妖兽。我等你。

10442403.en: Exploring the ley lines and uncovering the mysteries of the world—that is what interests me most right now.
10442403.ch: 查探地脉，洞悉八荒天机，是我目前最感兴趣的事。

10442404.en: The living are but passing guests; the dead have merely returned home. Beyond life and death, all else is mere dust and sand—utterly meaningless.
10442404.ch: 生者寄也，死者归也。生死之外，不过砂石泥尘，无关痛痒。

10442405.en: I have absolutely no interest in this matter. Let's not bring up old business again.
10442405.ch: 我对此事毫无兴趣，莫要旧事重提了。

10442406.en: I have unfinished business to attend to. Please don't bring this up again.
10442406.ch: 我大事未了，不要就是重提。

10442410.en: Only battles of life and death have meaning. All other combat is pointless.
10442410.ch: 除去生死搏斗，一切比斗都毫无意义。

10442416.en: You started this fight, so don't blame anyone else when blood is shed. Have at you!
10442416.ch: 既然你挑起此事，那么是生生死死，就怨不得旁人了，接招！

10442418.en: I once thought nothing mattered beyond life and death, but fate has shown me there are people and things I simply cannot forget.
10442418.ch: 原以为生死之外，并无值得称道的东西，但原来冥冥之中也会有些人，有些事，让我无法释怀。

10442419.en: I'm curious... aren't you afraid I might just swallow you whole?
10442419.ch: 我很好奇，你就不怕我一口把你吞了吗？

10442420.en: Most cultivators in the world are rather dim-witted. It's a miracle they've survived this long...
10442420.ch: 大多数八荒修士都有点蠢蠢的，他们活到现在，也是异数……

10442421.en: You might find this hard to believe, but it's true—I think you're special.
10442421.ch: 也许你觉得有点匪夷所思，不过这是真的，我觉得你很特别。

10442423.en: Hmph, I might want that too.

10442425.en: Take whatever you see. It's all yours.
10442425.ch: 但凡你看见的，取走即可。

10442428.en: I refuse. Tsk, quite eager for Dual Cultivation with me, aren't you?
10442428.ch: 我拒绝。啧，你似乎对与我双修，很感兴趣？

10442429.en: Sorry, but I'm not interested. Words and texts are full of flaws—using them to convey the truth is nothing but a fool's fantasy.
10442429.ch: 抱歉，我没兴趣。言语文字充满纰漏，借此载道，根本就是痴人说梦。

10442430.en: The thrill of the hunt drives one mad with excitement. But roaming about seeking pleasures rarely leads to anything good.
10442430.ch: 驰骋田猎令人心发狂。四处冶游，不见得是什么好事。

10442433.en: You started this fight, so don't blame anyone else for what happens next. Have at you!
10442433.ch: 既然你挑起此事，那么结局是生是死，就怨不得旁人了，接招！

10442434.en: The great path of heaven and earth towers beyond reach. Someone like me could never hope to touch such heights.
10442434.ch: 天地大道，高不可攀，就凭我，终究难以触其际涯。

10442435.en: The Nether Demons of Chi You may look formidable, but they're absolute fools, always walking straight into their deaths one after another.
10442435.ch: 赤幽州的冥妖看似厉害，实则愚蠢至极，总爱一个个地送羊入虎口。

10442436.en: There are many things in life we must eventually learn to let go.
10442436.ch: 有很多事终究是不得不放手的。

10442437.en: I won't agree to this. Humans and their bizarre thoughts...
10442437.ch: 我不会答应你的。人类的心思真是莫名其妙……

10442438.en: Oh? How interesting. Now that important matters are settled, I suppose I can humor your request.
10442438.ch: 噢？有意思。如今大事已了，我权且答应了你。

10442439.en: Such a greedy one, aren't you? Fine, I'll grant your wish for now—but if you dare betray me in the future, I'll swallow you whole.
10442439.ch: 贪得无厌的家伙。不过我权且依了你，来日你敢负我，便一口吞了你。

10442440.en: If you wish to be my Master, that would be absurd. And if you wish to be my Apprentice, I have no interest in accepting you under my tutelage.
10442440.ch: 如果你是想当我的师父，那就太过荒谬了。但如果你是想当我徒弟，我又不乐意将你收录于门墙之下。

10442441.en: Take it. It's nothing valuable anyway.
10442441.ch: 拿去吧，又不是什么贵重之物。

10442442.en: As they say, it's the thought that counts. I'll accept it. Um, thank you. I'm... truly touched.
10442442.ch: 人说物轻情意重，我姑且收下。嗯，谢谢你。我……很感动。

10442443.en: Usually, I don't accept gifts, but you're an exception. Thank you.
10442443.ch: 一般来说，我是不收礼的，但你是例外的。谢谢。

10442444.en: I refuse. This "sparring" of yours is merely how humans disguise their competitive nature.
10442444.ch: 我拒绝。所谓切磋不过是人类粉饰自己好胜心的手段而已。

10442445.en: Hmph, you're always going on about Dual Cultivation with me. Fine then, I'll indulge your wish.
10442445.ch: 哼，总是心心念念与我双修，既然如此便依了你吧。

10442446.en: Dual Cultivation of body and spirit is a delicate matter—one misstep could lead to Qi Deviation. But since you're willing to face these risks with me, why should I refuse?
10442446.ch: 性命双修，最是要紧，一着不慎，便要走火入魔，你既愿意与我同冒风险，那又有何不可？

10442448.en: I won't go. Isn't my dwelling far more interesting than those cookie-cutter landscapes out there?
10442448.ch: 不去。我的洞府不比那些个千篇一律的风景来得有意思？

10442449.en: I refuse. A sect is crawling with too many nobodies—I can't stand it.
10442449.ch: 我拒绝，宗门之中喽啰太多，我无法忍受。
